tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'brul gtor dbu'o// 'brul gtor bka' gdams lugs rnying ma'i gsung rtsom 'di mi phyugs sogs gzhan la dmigs nas gtong ba'i tshig bsgyur dang / dmigs pa ni/ dmigs yul lus las lus tshogs dpag med spros zhes dang / dmigs yul lus zhu mchod sprin 'di phul bas/ zhes dang / dmigs yul lus zhu dam rdzas 'di phul bas/ zhes dang / dmigs yul lus zhu 'dod yon 'di sbyin pas/ zhes dang / dmigs yul lus zhu sbyin pa mchog rab 'di zhes sbyar la/ dmigs pa ni/ mi phyugs shi gson gang yin de'i lus rang gi mdun du dmigs nas gtor ma so sor spro ba dang / mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gzhag rang don du yin na sna tshogs rang grol gyi gsungs 'di sor bzhag yin no// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ 'brul gtor dbu'o/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
